title: Benchmark registry and local baselines
objective: Create the benchmark registry and local baseline artifacts needed before wiring nightly CI.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E9 performance registry and baseline scope.

scope: Add a registry over public benchmark runners.
Capture wall time, solver iteration counts where available, and benchmark metrics.
implementation_steps: Confirm all prerequisite benchmark tasks are active before starting.
Add a registry that references public benchmark runners only.
Add metric capture and local smoke baseline comparison.
Add tests for registry completeness and baseline delta reporting.
Run targeted tests and static checks.
acceptance_criteria: P10-1 through P10-9 are represented in the registry.
Local performance test uses smoke settings.
Baseline comparison reports clear per-benchmark deltas.
risks: A registry created before upstream benchmark tasks are complete can encode missing semantics; mitigate by blocking this task on all active benchmark closures.
completion_notes: New mechdsl.verify.perf package: BenchmarkSpec, BenchmarkRegistry.default() (9 P10-1..P10-9 specs), run_smoke_registry, load_smoke_baseline, compare_to_baseline, ComparisonReport (JSON round-trip).
Committed smoke baseline at packages/mechdsl-core/tests/golden/perf/baseline_smoke.json + regen recipe in sibling README.md. Total smoke run wallclock ~12s on the dev laptop.

Phase 8 P8-2 carry-forward honored: P10-7 Taylor uses smoke() only (no nightly() — it overruns JC return-map iter budget; PEEQ unphysical at long horizons). P10-1 MMS restricted to Hex8 SVK with coarse mesh levels (4, 6, 8) for fast local execution.
Two minor cleanup items fixed by orchestrator before commit: (1) stripped Taichi import-banner noise from baseline JSON; (2) moved Callable/Iterator imports into TYPE_CHECKING block (TC003).
Implementer subagent shipped the modules + baseline but did not flesh out the test stubs; orchestrator completed the TDD step.
